Investigate this suspected problem.

Suspect S1: Missing authentication or authorization guard on admin endpoint
Category: security
Location: app/routes/admin.py lines 26-29 (new version)
Suspected problem: The newly added endpoint list_deactivated_users does not appear to check if the requesting user has administrator privileges, potentially allowing unauthorized access to user account data.
What would confirm or refute it: Check other endpoints in app/routes/admin.py or dependencies in the router setup to see how admin authentication and authorization are normally enforced.
